Status: wave 366: the Oscore transmission-parameter setters and the sequence-number advance

Method.evidence: Each Class1150 setter validates its argument and names the property in its own message: AcknowledgementTimeout, AcknowledgementTimeoutRandomnessFactor, MaximumNumberOfRetransmissions, NumberOfSimultaneousOutstandingInteractions and DefaultLeisure, so the accessor convention gives set_<Name>. Class1151s a(long) advances and range-checks the sender sequence number (SenderSequenceNumber exceeded maximal value of 0x{0:X}) and is GetNextSenderSequenceNumber. Gate: 6 added, 0 removed, 0 renamed.
Method.themes: Literal-carried property names are a third evidence class alongside self-naming operation literals and state-machine logs: the method validates value and prints the property it belongs to, which fixes the set_ name without inference.
